sources.title: BDUK Delivery Performance, annual: April 2025 to March 2026
Key findings, Statistical Digest of Rural England

candidates.name: Rural-urban current gigabit gap
candidates.gate: National residential context; not parcel availability.

candidates.name: Rural-urban projected gigabit gap
candidates.gate: Operator plans are forward-looking, not delivered coverage.

candidates.name: Projected gap compression
candidates.gate: Derived from Ofcom percentages; not a parcel forecast.

candidates.name: Rural gigabit planned growth
candidates.gate: Residential national model; no exact UPRN join.

candidates.name: Urban gigabit planned growth
candidates.gate: Residential national model; no exact UPRN join.

candidates.name: Rural annual delivery concentration
candidates.gate: Official annual delivery statistic; not current service availability.

candidates.name: Affordable decent broadband residual
candidates.gate: Includes satellite affordability assumptions; not fixed-network coverage.

candidates.name: Address checker freshness gate
candidates.value: January OMR, published June 2026; next update September 2026
candidates.gate: Checker data may lag supplier plan changes.

candidates.name: Address checker completeness gate
candidates.gate: Do not treat checker result as canonical parcel truth without corroboration.

candidates.name: High-confidence plan definition
candidates.value: Low Level Design Complete + committed funding
candidates.gate: Use high-confidence subset for forecasts; still not delivered coverage.

candidates.name: UPRN exact-join requirement
candidates.gate: Full source package, content hash and exact UPRN join required.

candidates.name: Rural disadvantage context
candidates.value: Most-rural broadband availability trails the rest of England
candidates.gate: Defra qualitative national context; no parcel scoring.

candidates.name: Single-runner recovery gate
candidates.value: Canonical heartbeat must advance before runtime
candidates.gate: Evidence-only work cannot replace the 74-step canonical execution.
